verdict.rationale: dlt is a data-loading library and platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence shows one: a first-party MCP server repo (dlt-hub/dlt-mcp), a published server card listing tools for inspecting, debugging and managing pipelines, secrets, schemas and runs, plus a read-only SQL query tool. The AI Harness docs also describe MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: detailed connection/configuration documentation for wiring an agent to the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
